verdict.rationale: Speechmatics documents a job-deletion capability that removes all associated resources, and states a default no-logging posture plus a self-hosted option for full data control. There is no evidence of configurable retention periods or policies, and the deletion evidence is a single thin line. Missing for 10: configurable retention windows/policies, detailed deletion API docs (scope, timing, transcript vs audio), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Delete a job and remove all associated resources.
We don’t log your data as standard.
